# Piece Exporting Flow in cart/editor — End-to-End Map

Important framing up front: in this cart there are **two distinct "export" concepts** that both touch the word "build piece," and they are NOT the same mechanism. Untangling them is the key to following the pattern for props:

- **(A) Model Package materialization** — writing a model to disk under `cart/editor/data/models/<category>/<slug>/` (category derived from `kind`: `props`/`build`/`characters`/`vehicles`). This is the on-disk directory format you found. Triggered by **Save Model to Library** and by imports, NOT by "Export Build Piece."
- **(B) "Export → Build Piece"** — the placeable-piece flow. Registers an `AuthoredBuildPiece` in `EditorState` (persisted to **localstore**, not to `models/`), caches its mesh, and makes it appear in the Build palette so it can be placed in the world. This is what wires a model into build mode as a placeable.

Both are "working." Below, each of your 5 questions is answered against both where relevant.

---

## 1. Where piece export is triggered in the UI

The **File → Export Build Piece → \<kind\>** menu flyout. It is NOT in BuildDock.tsx (that file is only a status/telemetry dock — FPS, undo counts, POS/GRID readouts; see `cart/editor/shell/BuildDock.tsx:70-140`).

Command registration:
- `cart/editor/data/commands.ts:50-56` — `EXPORT_BUILD_COMMANDS = KIND_ORDER.map(k => ({ id: 'export-build-piece-${k}', menu: 'File', submenu: 'Export Build Piece', ... scope: 'model' }))`. One leaf per `BuildKind`.
- `cart/editor/data/commands.ts:79` — spread into the `File` menu (`...EXPORT_BUILD_COMMANDS`).
- `cart/editor/data/commands.ts:296` — the nested menu tree node: `{ kind: 'sub', id: 'Export Build Piece', label: 'Build Piece', icon: 'PackagePlus', scope: 'model', children: EXPORT_BUILD_COMMANDS.map(...) }`.
- `scope: 'model'` means the command is only enabled when a **model document** is the active surface (a model must be open in the editor).

`BuildKind` (the 13 kinds that become flyout leaves): `cart/editor/world/buildCatalog.ts:20-22` — `wall | floor | roof | ramp | stairs | elevator | pillar | corner | arch | fence | railing | trim | sign`.

"Piece" in this cart = a **placeable build element** snapped to a 3 m grid module (`PIECE_MODULE_METERS = 3`, `cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:140`), with a base **kind** that drives snap affinity (edge-snap for walls/corners/arches/fences/railings; center-snap plates otherwise — `cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:152`). A piece can be either a **catalog piece** (one of the host's 36 `BUILD_CATALOG` rows) or an **authored piece** (a user model exported as a piece).

---

## 2. What gets written on export — on-disk package format

The on-disk directory format lives under `cart/editor/data/models/<category>/<slug>/`. **This format is written by Model Package materialization (Save to Library / import), not by the Export Build Piece command** (see §3). Category dir from `kind`: `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:67-75` (`build→build`, `character→characters`, `vehicle→vehicles`, `prop/default→props`).

**Directory skeleton** (`cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:14-22, 34`): each model dir contains `manifest.json` + four subdirs `mesh/ atlases/ paints/ shaders/` (`MODEL_PACKAGE_SUBDIRS`).

On-disk contents I observed:
- **`build/cooked_studio.wall_with_cover/`** — `manifest.json`, `mesh/base.blob` (10 KB, content-addressed interleaved verts), `atlases/base.png` (143 B), empty `paints/`, empty `shaders/`.
- **`props/primitive_cube_1/`** — `manifest.json`, `mesh/base.blob`, `atlases/base.png`, `paints/paint_1.json` + `paints/paint_1.png`, empty `shaders/`.
- **`props/import_joyful_run/`** — `manifest.json`, `mesh/joyful_run.glb` (the imported source file travels inside the package), empty atlases/paints/shaders.
- **`props/nug_461f32af/`** (tracked) — `manifest.json`, `mesh/nug_461f32af.obj`, `preview.png` (note: no atlases/paints/shaders subdirs — older/generated layout).

**Manifest schema** — `ModelManifest` type at `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:40-63`; serialized pretty (2-space) via `serializeManifest` (`:166-168`); parsed tolerantly via `parseManifest` (`:172-178`, requires string `id` + `kind`).

Representative BUILD manifest (`cart/editor/data/models/build/cooked_studio.wall_with_cover/manifest.json`):
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "id": "cooked:studio.wall_with_cover",
  "name": "wall_with_cover",
  "kind": "build",
  "stage": "ready",
  "folderId": "model-cooked_studio.wall_with_cover",
  "semanticKind": "wall",
  "sourceKind": "cooked-asset",
  "color": "#a34e43",
  "rig": "0 mounts",
  "data": "hash 064c3901",
  "triangles": 108,
  "lods": 0,
  "mesh": { "viewerMeshRef": "b981e76fc41b50dff9253eae69fdb1d88945fa73a4d6049d3a7b52a00fad296b" },
  "decompositions": ["semantic:wall", "mesh:b981e76f", "texture:-"],
  "atlases": [ { "id": "studio.wall_with_cover:mesh", "label": "mesh blob", "scope": "108 tris", "resolution": "content-addressed", "paints": 0, "color": "#a34e43" } ],
  "paints": []
}
```

Representative PROP manifest — imported (`props/import_joyful_run/manifest.json`):
```json
{
  "version": 1, "id": "import:joyful_run", "name": "Joyful Run",
  "kind": "prop", "stage": "ready", "folderId": "props",
  "semanticKind": "prop", "sourceKind": "source-file",
  "color": "#4fa343", "rig": "source model file", "data": "file joyful_run.glb",
  "triangles": 0, "lods": 0,
  "mesh": { "viewerPath": "cart/editor/data/models/props/import_joyful_run/mesh/joyful_run.glb" },
  "decompositions": ["semantic:prop", "format:glb", "imported-from:/home/siah/Downloads/joyful_run.glb"],
  "atlases": [], "paints": []
}
```

Representative PROP manifest — primitive (`props/primitive_cube_1/manifest.json`): `id:"primitive:cube:1"`, `kind:"prop"`, `stage:"wip"`, `sourceKind:"primitive"`, `semanticKind:"cube"`, `mesh:{}` (empty — geometry re-generated on load from `semanticKind` as the seed, per `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:159-162`).

Key manifest-field distinctions relevant to mesh resolution:
- `mesh.viewerMeshRef` — content-addressed hash for cooked/saved-to-library blobs (`base.blob`).
- `mesh.viewerPath` — an on-disk file path for file-backed models (`.glb`/`.obj`); geometry lives host-side.
- neither present + `sourceKind:"primitive"` — re-generated from `semanticKind`.

**Paint blob format** (`props/primitive_cube_1/paints/paint_1.json`): `{ id, name, w, h, detail, data (base64 RJPP program), format:"program", png:"...paint_1.png" }`. Paints are written separately by the paint-variant flow, not the base save.

## 3. The code path that performs the export

### 3a. Model Package materialization (the disk writer — §2's format)
- **Format/paths (pure)**: `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts` — `packageDir`, `manifestPath`, `subDir`, `packageToManifest`/`manifestToPackage`, `serializeManifest`/`parseManifest`.
- **IO half**: `cart/editor/data/modelPackageStore.ts`:
  - `materializeModelPackage(pkg)` (`:38-47`) — mkdir the category+model dirs and the four subdirs, then `writeFile(manifestPath, serializeManifest(packageToManifest(pkg)))`.
  - `writeModelArtifacts(pkg)` (`:184-196`) — writes `mesh/base.blob` via host door **`__model_mesh_write`**, and `atlases/base.png` via **`__model_atlas_read`** (JSON) → **`__image_write_png`**.
  - `copyModelPackage` (`:97-128`), `updateManifestIdentity` (`:75-89`), `loadMaterializedPackages` (`:143-161`), `listPackageFiles` (`:170-176`), `isMaterialized` (`:65-67`).
  - fs primitives imported from `runtime/hooks/fs` (`:13`): `exists, listDir, mkdir, readFile, readFileBase64, writeFile, writeFileBase64Atomic`.
- **Triggered from**: **Save Model to Library** (`save-snapshot` command) in `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:407-413` (`materializeModelPackage` then `writeModelArtifacts`). Also on **import** (`importModelFilePackage`, `cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts:658-684`, materializes + copies bytes into `mesh/`).

### 3b. Export → Build Piece (the placeable writer — the actual "piece export")
Handled in `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:428-464` (the `command.id.startsWith('export-build-piece-')` branch):
1. Parse the kind: `const kind = command.id.slice('export-build-piece-'.length) as BuildKind` (`:434`).
2. Resolve the open model's effective package (`effectiveModelPackage`, honoring renames) (`:437`); bail with a status if no model is open (`:438-441`).
3. Strip `studio:` prefix → bare `modelId` (`:442`).
4. Resolve geometry through the **one** resolver the viewer uses — live unsaved parts win, else `modelPackageMeshData(pkg)` (`:447-448`), and `cacheAuthoredMesh(modelId, captured)` (`:449`).
5. Build the placeable: `const piece: AuthoredBuildPiece = { id: authoredIdFor(modelId), modelId, pkgId: pkg.id, label: pkg.name, kind, hex: pkg.color }` (`:452`).
6. Commit to state: add to `authoredBuildPieces` (dedup by id), set `armedPieceId`, switch `actionMenu` to `Build` (`:453-462`).

Note: **this path writes NO files.** It does not call `materializeModelPackage`. Persistence is via localstore (§4). Mesh geometry travels to the host via the resident-mesh path (§4), not via disk.

- Mesh resolver (the single source of vertices, any storage form): `modelPackageMeshData` at `cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts:203-216` — primitive → content-addressed blob (`cookedMeshBlobData`) → stored EditMesh parts.
- Authored mesh cache/lookup: `cart/editor/world/authoredMesh.ts` — `cacheAuthoredMesh` (`:13`), `authoredMeshData` (`:20`), `authoredMeshBounds` (`:35`).

---

## 4. How exported pieces get PLACED in build mode

### Registry / state
- `AuthoredBuildPiece` type: `cart/editor/world/authoredRegistry.ts:12-25` (`id` namespaced `model:<modelId>`, `modelId`, `pkgId`, `label`, `kind`, `hex`).
- Live module mirror: `setAuthoredPieces` / `authoredList` / `authoredPieceFor` / `isAuthoredPiece` / `placeableKind` (`:35-56`). AppFrame mirrors state→registry each change at `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:184-186`.
- **Persistence**: `EditorState.authoredBuildPieces` (`cart/editor/data/types.ts:461`), seeded from **localstore** `nsGet('editor','authoredBuildPieces')` — `loadAuthoredPieces`/`saveAuthoredPieces` at `cart/editor/data/initialState.ts:14-26`, seeded at `:100`. AppFrame saves on change (`:185`). So exported pieces survive a cold restart via localstore; geometry is re-resolved from the model store on load.

### The palette (browser listing exported pieces)
- `cart/editor/stage/BuildBar.tsx` — the Sims-style build palette, pinned to the bottom of the world viewport in Place mode. Category header row + tile tray.
- Source of the list: `placeablesByKind()` (`cart/editor/world/authoredRegistry.ts:63-74`) — catalog rows first, then authored pieces of matching affinity appended under that kind. Authored tiles get a `◆` marker (`BuildBar.tsx:113`).
- Tiles render real product-shot thumbnails: authored pieces photograph `authoredMeshData(...)`; catalog pieces photograph `catalogPieceThumbParts` (`BuildBar.tsx:33-50`).
- Clicking a tile → `onArm(entry.id)` → `armPiece` in AppFrame (`cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:741-749`), sets `state.armedPieceId`.

### Placement code path
- Snap/validate: `resolvePlacement(pieceId, wx, wz, floor, terrainY)` — `cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:184-196`. Edge-snap vs center-snap by kind; validates catalog pieces via host `validateBuildPlacement` (framework/game/build.zig); returns a `PlacedPiece`.
- Viewport ties it together: `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx` — `resolveSnap` (`:320-330`) → ghost preview → click → placement. Ground raycast is terrain-aware via `__compiled_world_ground_hit` (`:306-318`).
- Commit: `placePiece` in `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:713-731` — assigns id `bp_<seq>`, computes `placementSlotKey` (`cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:204-211`) to **replace** any piece already occupying that footprint, appends to `worldPieces`, records a world-undo edit.

### Where placements are stored
- `EditorState.worldPieces: PlacedPiece[]` — `cart/editor/data/types.ts:456`; initial `[]` at `cart/editor/data/initialState.ts:95`. This is the world-domain placement list (in editor state, undo-tracked via `WORLD_UNDO_KEYS`, `cart/editor/shell/AppFrame.tsx:640`). `PlacedPiece` type at `cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:39-58` (id, pieceId, x/y/z, yawDegrees, floor, slots, overrides). There is no separate `world/` on-disk placement file — placements live in editor state.

### How placed authored pieces render (mesh, not box)
The bridge to the host live mesh-prop path: `cart/editor/world/meshProps.ts`:
- `encodeResidentMeshes(meshes)` (`:53-95`) — MESH_PROPS lump (version 7, `instanceCount 0`), a catalog of resident meshes keyed by `modelId`.
- `encodeMeshRefs(refs)` / `encodeMeshGhost(ref)` (`:101-128`) — per-placement 24-byte refs; hash via `meshKeyHash` (FNV-1a, must match `world_loader.zig liveMeshHash`, `:18-25`).
- Pushed from `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx`: resident catalog via `__compiled_world_set_resident_meshes` (`:255-273`, retries until loader node exists), per-placement refs via `__compiled_world_set_live_mesh_props` (`:241-248`), armed ghost via `__compiled_world_set_live_mesh_ghost` (`:278-288`). Catalog (non-authored) pieces instead go through `pieceInstanceRows` → `__compiled_world_set_live_pieces` (`cart/editor/world/pieces.ts:262-285`, `WorldViewport.tsx:227`); authored pieces are skipped there (`pieces.ts:265`) because they render via the mesh path.

---

## 5. Anything stubbed / half-built for PROPS specifically

There is **no `export-prop`/place-prop-in-world flow yet**. "Prop" today is only a **model library `kind`**, not a placeable. Findings:

- **`kind: 'prop'` is a model category only.** Category dir mapping `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:72-73`; UI tab/folder mapping in `cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts` (`'models-props'`/`'Props'` at `:442, :970, :1034`; `cookedUiCategory` splits build vs prop at `:1111-1112`; `kind: category==='build' ? 'build' : 'prop'` at `:868, :914`).
- **Imported-prop pipeline exists** (source data ingestion, not world placement): `ImportedPropSource`/`ImportedPropsData` types (`cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts:122-136`), `IMPORTED_PROPS_DATA = 'cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/importedProps.data.json'` (`:17`), `importedPropModelPackages` (`:534-566`) → produces `kind:'prop'`, `sourceKind:'imported-prop'` packages.
- **Design note anticipating prop export** (`cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts:1145-1146`): *"…mesh editor (studio-model), then export it as a prop to get it into the game (imported-prop / cooked-asset / source-file)."* The stage-rank helper `modelStageRank` (`:1146-1173`) already ranks `imported-prop`/`cooked-asset` as export outputs — but the export **action** for props is not wired.
- The **Export flyout is build-only** — it iterates `KIND_ORDER` (build kinds), with no prop leaf (`cart/editor/data/commands.ts:53`). No `export-prop-*` command exists.
- `BuildKind` has no prop member (`cart/editor/world/buildCatalog.ts:20-22`), and `placeablesByKind` only groups build kinds, so props can never appear in the Build palette today.
- Other `prop` hits are unrelated: material/shader taxonomy "Props & Clutter" (`cart/editor/textures/shaders.ts:295,355-365`) and React `props` params.

---

## Pattern to mirror for prop exporting (synthesis)

To make props follow the "piece exporting" pattern, the analogues you'd replicate are:
1. A command family like `export-prop-*` (or a single `export-prop`) alongside `EXPORT_BUILD_COMMANDS` at `cart/editor/data/commands.ts:50-56`, added to the File menu + menu tree.
2. An `AppFrame.tsx` handler mirroring `:428-464` that builds a placeable prop record from the open model (reuse `effectiveModelPackage`, `modelPackageMeshData`, `cacheAuthoredMesh`, `authoredMeshData`).
3. A registry mirroring `authoredRegistry.ts` (its own persisted state key like `authoredBuildPieces` in `initialState.ts:14-26` + `types.ts:461`), and a placeables grouping so props surface in a palette (parallel to `placeablesByKind`).
4. A placement path: props likely want **free/no-grid placement** (unlike the 3 m edge/center snap in `pieces.ts`), stored in `worldPieces` or a sibling `worldProps` list, rendered via the **same host mesh-prop bridge** (`meshProps.ts` + the `__compiled_world_set_resident_meshes`/`set_live_mesh_props` pushes in `WorldViewport.tsx:241-273`) — that bridge is already generic to any resident mesh keyed by `modelId`, so it needs no change.
5. Disk materialization already works for `kind:'prop'` (`materializeModelPackage` routes to `models/props/`), so "save prop to library" is done; only the **placeable/export-into-world** half is missing.</result>
